title: embedding
instructions: A tool call that creates something is answered with the nearest few existing entities of its kind, each a `hit` whose `near` names the new one. When one of them is the same thing, keep the one that stands: update it, and delete the new one.

vector_check.title: Check the vector index
vector_check.description: Check the vector index used to rank entities by semantic similarity. Reports missing embedding configuration or a missing vector table. Reports a stale populated index when its dirty flag (needs rebuilding) remains set and the newest vector is older than the server’s stale threshold, 30 minutes by default. This can reveal a stopped rebuild process even though writes succeed and searches still return results from the last good build. Takes no arguments. Returns a report in content.body, with warning or failure findings when present; it does not repair the records or configuration.
